## Modules

### `cypera-core`

cypera-core — pure domain for cypera, the org's reusable
documentation/reference-generation tool.

Everything here is string/AST-shape in, markdown out — **no
I/O**. `cypera-cli` owns filesystem walks, process spawning, and
stdout; this crate owns the models and the renderers:

- [`manifest`] — `Cargo.toml` decoding (workspace members +
per-crate manifests).
- [`crate_map`] — the crate-map model + markdown renderer
(successor to the per-repo `docs/gen-crate-map.py` scripts).
- [`config`] — Rust config-struct doc-comment scanning + the
config-reference page renderer (successor to
`docs/gen-config-docs.py`).
- [`cli`] — the CLI-reference page wrapper for `gen-cli-docs`
output (the `clap-markdown` markdown sibling CLIs emit).

Modules: `cli`, `config`, `crate_map`, `error`, `manifest`, `repo_config`. Entry: `src/lib.rs`.

### `cypera-xtask`

cypera-xtask — workspace automation: check / test / coverage / fmt.

```text
cargo xtask check      # fmt --check + clippy -D warnings
cargo xtask test       # cargo nextest run (falls back to cargo test)
cargo xtask coverage   # llvm-cov report (extra args pass through)
cargo xtask fmt        # cargo fmt --all
```

No module declarations. Entry: `src/main.rs`.

### `cypera`

cypera — reusable documentation/reference generation for the 9aia
org. The shared successor to the per-repo `docs/gen-*.py`
scripts: one tool renders the crate map, CLI reference, and
config reference pages every sibling docs site needs, driven by
a per-repo `cypera.toml` discovered upward from `--repo`.

```text
cypera gen crate-map [--repo <path>] [--config <path>] [--out <file>] [--layer <crate=layer>]…
cypera gen cli       [--repo <path>] [--config <path>] [--input <file|->] [--out <file>]
cypera gen config    [--repo <path>] [--config <path>] [--file <rs>]… [--out <file>]
cypera check         [--repo <path>] [--config <path>] [--json]
```

All generation logic lives in `cypera-core` (pure); this crate
owns argv, `cypera.toml` discovery, filesystem walks, process
spawning, and stdout.

Modules: `check`. Entry: `src/lib.rs`.
